answer: The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, split across independent auditors, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the beacon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the nectar until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the juniper of the next round.
